subject: Short-term net45 pilot & temporary credit buffer request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightpath.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts@brightpath.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term net45 pilot & temporary credit buffer

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding so far. We're seeing a short timing mismatch between expected funding and our AR cycle this quarter and I wanted to ask whether Redwood would consider a short-term change to our payment terms and credit line while we bridge.

Specifically: can BrightPath run a 90-day pilot on net45 (instead of our current net30) and be granted a temporary credit buffer of $200,000 for Q2 invoices? The buffer would only be for 3 invoices (April–June) and we'd revert to our standard credit limit after that.

We can provide a PO for the pilot and are happy to sign any amendment if Redwood needs it. A couple of practical questions:
- Do you need a company-level credit check or is the AR/aging report sufficient?
- For our EU entity (BrightPath EU SRL) — how should we handle VAT on invoices? We can provide VAT registration documentation.

I've attached our Q1 AR report for context (BrightPath_Q1_AR_Report.xlsx). If useful, I'm happy to jump on a 20–30 minute call to run through the numbers — Wed or Thu mornings PST work best for us.

Appreciate your help,

Samir Patel
CFO, BrightPath Analytics
samir.patel@brightpath.ai
+1 (415) 555-0139

Attachment: BrightPath_Q1_AR_Report.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightpath.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term net45 pilot & temporary credit buffer

Hi Samir — thanks for the context and the AR file. Short answer: I think we can get you a short-term accommodation, but we need to lock a few guardrails so risk stays acceptable on our side. Proposed approach below.

Proposed pilot (90 days):
- Net45 for invoices dated April–June 2027.
- Temporary credit buffer: +$150,000 to your existing limit for the duration of the pilot.
- Security: 25% upfront payment on the first invoice in the pilot window (applied to that invoice).
- Documentation: signed amendment (simple one-page addendum), updated PO for the pilot, and an ACH mandate (or cleared wire) for the upfront.

VAT handling for BrightPath EU SRL: please send the VAT registration certificate and the legal name you want on EU invoices; we'll route EU invoices via our EU billing subsidiary and mark them appropriately (we'll need to validate the VAT number before issuing).

Next steps from Redwood: I'll loop in Finance and Legal to confirm the temporary buffer and draft the amendment. Marissa (Finance) — can you run a quick credit parse against the AR attached and confirm whether +$150k is doable with a 25% upfront? Karthik — can Legal produce a short addendum template we can send to Samir? Ben — I copied you to coordinate the PO and set up the DocuSign.

I've attached a quick sketch of a payment schedule for clarity (proposed_payment_schedule_v1.pdf). If the above works, Samir, I'll get you the amendment and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0214

Attachment: proposed_payment_schedule_v1.pdf (pdf)

Laura / team —

Saw the AR file and the proposed payment sketch. Quick finance take: we can support an incremental buffer but need either a 25% upfront or an approved credit check with trade references. For clarity:
- If BrightPath provides 25% of the first pilot invoice up front, we can approve a +$150k buffer immediately (subject to legal addendum).
- If they prefer no upfront, we need a completed credit check form + one trade reference (30 days turnaround for the review).

Operational asks:
- We need a PO number tied to the pilot dates and line items (so A/P can route correctly).
- For EU VAT: the VAT certificate will suffice; once validated we'll issue EU-compliant invoices to the EU legal entity.

I'm attaching the credit check form we use internally to speed the latter path. If Samir can do the 25% upfront, that will significantly speed approval and avoid a multi-week review.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: credit-check-form.pdf (pdf)

Hi Laura / Marissa / Ben —

Appreciate the fast responses. Two quick notes from our side:
1) We can do an upfront payment but 25% is a little high for internal approvals; would Redwood accept 20% on the first invoice? That would get us most of the way there.
2) VAT: BrightPath EU SRL is the legal entity that should receive EU invoices. VAT reg: BE0123456789 (see attached certificate). We will not be changing the legal entity; just need invoices routed and taxed correctly.

On invoice splitting: is Redwood able to split a single monthly invoice across BrightPath Inc (US) and BrightPath EU SRL (EU) if the usage mix requires it? If not, we can accept separate invoices per legal entity — whatever is easiest for your A/P.

I've attached the VAT certificate (BrightPath_VAT_cert.pdf). If you can confirm the 20% upfront is acceptable and we can do separate EU invoices, we can return a signed PO tomorrow morning and wire the upfront the same day.

Thanks,
Samir

Attachment: BrightPath_VAT_cert.pdf (pdf)

We're willing to accept the 20% upfront on the first pilot invoice in exchange for a reduced temporary buffer. Revised terms below:
- Net45 for April–June 2027 (pilot).
- Temporary credit buffer: +$125,000 for the pilot period.
- 20% upfront on the first invoice in the pilot window (wired or ACH).
- Separate invoicing to BrightPath Inc (US) and BrightPath EU SRL (EU) supported — we'll route EU invoices via our EU billing entity once VAT reg is validated.
- Required items to go live: signed amendment (DocuSign link below), PO referencing the pilot dates, and ACH/wire confirmation for the upfront.

DocuSign (amendment): https://docusign.com/rw/8342

Samir — if that all works, can we schedule a quick 15-minute check at 10:00 AM PST on Thu, 18 Mar to confirm we've got the PO and payment in place? I can send a calendar invite.
